chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Today's topic is Data Abstruction in ER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In ER model, we will see what is Data Abstruction

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Data Abstruction is used to represent complex relationship between entities

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If you want to create complex relationship between entities

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Data Abstruction is introduced to reduce complexity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It means we can create complex relationship between entities

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: With the help of Data Abstruction

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In the last video, we covered ER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In which we created an ER diagram on a topic

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: On the University Management System

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: There were many complexities in making ER Diagram

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In which we did without Data Abstruction

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: But if a big project comes up, we can define ER Model

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: There are many entities where there is a problem

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: To deal with that problem, there are three mechanisms in Data Abstruction

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Which are generalization, aggregation and specialization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: What does generalization do?

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It is a process of converting low-level entity to high-level entity called generalization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It is called generalization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Suppose we have three entities

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Teacher, Employee, Student

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have three tables

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Teacher, Employee and Student

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: With similar attributes like name and age

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Name and age will be in the three

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: These are common attributes

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Generalization would combine these low-level entity into a generalized entity called person

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: The low-level entity we have here is a student, employee

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: By combining these three, we have created a generalized entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: In which we have common attributes like name and age

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It is called bottom-up approach

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It is called generalization to create a high-level entity from a low-level entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: What can we do now?

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We can design a model of the previous entity through this generalized entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have reduced complexity here

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We have created a high-level entity by removing common attributes from these three low-level entities

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: So complexity is over here

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: This is generalization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: The second type of data abstraction is specialization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It is a positive generalization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It creates sub-entity from a high-level entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: For example, an employee is a high-level entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: It can specialize it into sub-entities like manager and developer based on attributes

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Here we have an employee's ID

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We are creating a low-level entity from a high-level entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Manager and developer

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: This is also an ID

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: The manager is an employee in himself

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: The developer is also an employee in himself

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If we are creating a low-level entity from a high-level entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: We call it specialization

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: This is our top-down approach

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: The third type is aggregation

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Aggregation is a process when a relation between two entities is treated as a single entity

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: There are two entities here

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Learn coding and course

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If we treat these two entities as a single entity like visitors

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: If any of the visitors are coming to our channel on learn coding

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: They are the only entity on our channel

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: But here we get to read a lot of courses

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: CEC++, Java, Python

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: They are the only learning coding channel

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: They are single entities

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: But there are a lot of courses

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Single entity is treated in a lot of entities

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Through these visitors

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: You are studying different courses on the channel by enquiring

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: Single entity is offering multiple courses

chunks.title: lecture
chunks.text: This is called aggregation
